mapper.select: SELECT id AS knowledgeId, plus_dsi_name AS knowledgeName, plus_dsi_introduction AS introduction, plus_dsi_damagesym AS damageSymptom, plus_dsi_ofactor AS occurrenceRule, plus_dsi_cmethod AS controlMethod FROM knowledge WHERE isdeleted = 0 AND ( TRIM(plus_dsi_name) = TRIM(#{diseaseName}) OR FIND_IN_SET( TRIM(#{diseaseName}), REPLACE( REPLACE( REPLACE( REPLACE(COALESCE(plus_dsi_synonyms, ''), '、', ','), '，', ',' ), '；', ',' ), ';', ',' ) ) > 0 ) ORDER BY CASE WHEN TRIM(plus_dsi_name) = TRIM(#{diseaseName}) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, CASE WHEN #{cropType} IS NOT NULL AND #{cropType} != '' AND plus_dsi_categorythird = #{cropType} THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, id LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE xwq_ai_disease SET disease_advice = #{controlMethod}, disease_desc = CASE WHEN disease_desc IS NULL OR TRIM(disease_desc) = '' OR disease_desc = '暂无症状描述' THEN COALESCE(#{damageSymptom}, disease_desc) ELSE disease_desc END WHERE disease_id = #{diseaseId}
